PROJECTS
AI Sales Forecaster | Python, LightGBM, XGBoost, Prophet, Streamlit Oct 2026
- Forecasts daily demand for 500 store-item series up to 90 days ahead, trained on a 913,000-row Kaggle retail dataset.
- Compared 5 models with time-series cross-validation; LightGBM achieved 29% lower error than the "same day last year" baseline (MAE 
5.90, MAPE 12.93%), with 80% prediction intervals (79.3% coverage).
- Deployed a 6-page dashboard with SHAP explanations, anomaly detection, what-if promotion and price scenarios, an inventory planner 
(safety stock, reorder point), CSV upload and Excel export.
Live demo: sales-forecaster-demo.example.app | Code: github.com/zoyafarhan-example/sales-forecaster
Resume and Job Matcher | Python, sentence-transformers, scikit-learn, Streamlit Oct 2026
- Scores a CV against a job description out of 100 from 5 weighted components (skills, semantic similarity, keywords, experience, 
education), using MiniLM sentence embeddings and a 98-skill taxonomy.
- Includes an ATS-readiness check, keyword gap highlighting, a bullet-point improver, a PDF report, a compare-3-jobs view and a recruiter 
mode that ranks CVs and exports a CSV shortlist.
- Reached 0.98 pairwise ranking accuracy on 32 hand-labelled CV/job pairs, ranking the best CV first for 4 of 4 jobs; covered by 15 
automated tests and runs with no paid API keys.
Maths AI Tutor | Python, Ollama (Qwen2.5-3B), Streamlit, SQLite Oct 2026
- Built an offline maths tutor for Grades 3 to 6 that runs a local language model to give step-by-step hints in Urdu and Roman Urdu; pilot 
with students not yet run.
- Uses a 60-question bank with code-verified answers, a safety filter that blocks hints revealing the answer, adaptive difficulty and a 
caretaker progress dashboard with CSV export.
